| L2 | [DNS Resolution](00-foundations/networking/dns-resolution.md) | concept | DNS is a globally distributed cache with no invalidation — which is why it is fast, and why it lies. |
| L2 | [Linux Processes and Signals](00-foundations/linux/linux-processes.md) | concept | Every process on Linux is a copy of another process — there is exactly one exception, and it is PID 1. |
